message: 色彩

name: Azel
message: 「What a strange color.」

name: Melilot
message: 「It is sepia-toned.」

name: Azel
message: 「What is that?」

name: Melilot
message: 「That photograph was taken using film invented during the transition from black-and-white to today's full natural color.」

name: Azel
message: 「I see. Understood.」
Whoa, that's unusual.
Coming to the library to look up things about Christmas, I stumble upon an unexpected sight.
Azel and Melilot-san were sitting side by side in the reading room. Stacks of photo books are piled up on the table.

name: Melilot
message: 「As you can tell from the colors of the photographs, this world progresses step by step.」

name: Azel
message: 「I didn't ask for all that.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Heehee, my apologies.」

name: Synn
message: 「H-huh?! There's stuff other than photo books too, huh?」
Giving the two of them a nod, I take a seat with them.
Several photo books placed on the desk. Unadorned and unpretentious, capturing ordinary townscapes and people's daily lives. Yet, mixed in among them is a single illustrated reference book.

name: Melilot
message: 「It is the Great Encyclopedia of Cameras. Since Azel-san seemed to have an interest in photographs, I brought it along.」

name: Azel
message: 「I have no interest in the machines that take the photographs themselves.」
Saying that, Azel picks up the Great Encyclopedia of Cameras and begins flipping through the pages.

name: Azel
message: 「They photographed a camera with a camera. Pointless.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahahaha, could it be that actually hit your funny bone, Azel?」

name: Azel
message: 「I-I wouldn't know!」

name: Azel
message: 「There are too many types. Which one is the best camera?」

name: Melilot
message: 「It depends on the intended use, though in terms of performance, a single-lens reflex would be the safest choice.」

name: Azel
message: 「Which one is that?」
Oh, right. Azel just arrived as an exchange student, so he still can't read this country's script very well.
Is that why he's drawn to photo books?

name: Melilot
message: 「Here it is」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa, that looks expensive」

name: Azel
message: 「I don't care about the price. What's so good about this camera?」

name: Melilot
message: 「It can take photographs that are closest to the scene captured by the naked eye」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, due to a structural flaw, the image vanishes from the viewfinder at the exact moment the photo is taken, making the subject invisible」

name: Azel
message: 「You take pictures of things you can't see?」

name: Melilot
message: 「You can see them right before and right after」

name: Azel
message: 「Still, you can't see it at the very moment you want to shoot, right? So in the end, you just end up with a counterfeit photograph?」

name: Synn
message: 「Even if it turns out different from what you expected, it's better than nothing」

name: Azel
message: 「Incomprehensible」

name: Melilot
message: 「Then how about this photo book? Every single shot in it was taken using an SLR camera」
Melilot hands Azel a particularly thin booklet from a tall pile of books.

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, that cover is――」

name: Azel
message: 「Beautiful」
On the page Azel opened to is a photograph of a stone bed and a room painted the exact same vermilion as Azel's hair.

name: Azel
message: 「Where is this?」

name: Synn
message: 「That's Ryuusei Town」

name: Azel
message: 「Near here!?」

name: Melilot
message: 「It actually exists right next to Asukai Shrine」

name: Azel
message: 「I want to go there!」

name: Melilot
message: 「That's impossible. It no longer exists」

name: Azel
message: 「You're contradicting yourself」

name: Azel
message: 「Gorgeous」
Azel gazes intently at the photo on the next page. A young man and woman dressed in dazzling attire are sleeping peacefully, snuggled close together on the stone bed.

name: Azel
message: 「So serene. I'd like to try sleeping like that too」

name: Melilot
message: 「...Those two are dead」

name: Azel
message: 「Don't lie to me. They look completely alive」

name: Melilot
message: 「They had turned into adipocere」

name: Azel
message: 「What is 'shirou'?」

name: Synn
message: 「Listen, Azel, that place is a minor ruin--」
I tell Azel everything I know about it.
A few years before I was born, a weekend photographer stumbled across it by chance while walking along a mountain trail beside Asukai Shrine.
A mountainside collapsed by long rains. A stone door with its gaps carefully sealed with clay.
I can't blame him for opening it. I'm sure I would have done the exact same thing.
It was an untouched ruin, a stone chamber with its entire interior painted vermilion.
It could only be called a miracle.
Enshrined in ancient times, the remains of the king and queen had turned into adipocere by a whim of nature, preserving their exact appearance from when they were alive.
After snapping several photos with trembling hands, he hurried down the mountain and called the police.
And when he returned to the ruin with the officers who had received his report--
Everything was gone.
It hadn't been looted by grave robbers.
The colors that had been preserved by the airtight seal faded and vanished in an instant upon touching the fresh air that rushed inside.
In the spot where the lifelike king and queen had been laid to rest, only two lumps of earth remained.

name: Melilot
message: 「There may have been other burial goods as well, though we will never know now」

name: Melilot
message: 「And only a handful of photographs remain」

name: Azel
message: 「I see. Understood.」

name: Synn
message: 「Everyone who grew up in Ryuusei Town always goes to visit those ruins on a school field trip」

name: Synn
message: 「And the standard route after that is the museum. Nanaka and I went too, and Misa and Shio-chan must have seen it as well」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes, if you don't mind reproductions, they are on permanent display at the museum. The likenesses of those two are also recreated just as they appear in those photographs」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, and if you show your Ryuusei Academy student ID at the entrance, you can get in for free」

name: Azel
message: 「It's free!?」

name: Azel
message: 「I see, let's go right now」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, they are ultimately imitations, you know?」

name: Azel
message: 「B-Better than nothing」

name: Melilot
message: 「No time like the present. That was certainly a worthwhile viewing」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes, it somehow feels pretty good」

name: Synn
message: 「Alright, time to head to the Student Council room! I've got a feeling I'll come up with some good ideas today」

name: Melilot
message: 「Before you do that, please put all of the photobooks back on the bookshelf」

name: Synn
message: 「M-Me?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Azel-san has already left the building. And you are her classmate, Sakura-kun. Isn't what that connection implies obvious?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Heehee」
